static_well.label: Static well (control)
static_well.description: No perfusion, atmospheric oxygen, no deliberate exogenous stressor -- an illustrative baseline dish, not an organ-chip condition.

liver_chip_like.label: Liver-chip-like (low flow, physioxia)
liver_chip_like.description: Illustrative low-perfusion, low-oxygen-tension, metabolically demanding profile evoking a liver-chip's physioxia -- not a calibrated hepatocyte model.

lung_chip_like.label: Lung-chip-like (high flow, high O2)
lung_chip_like.description: Illustrative high-perfusion, atmospheric-oxygen, nutrient-replete profile evoking a lung-chip's air-liquid interface -- not a calibrated alveolar model.

gut_chip_like.label: Gut-chip-like (nutrient-limited)
gut_chip_like.description: Illustrative moderate-flow, low-oxygen, nutrient-depleted profile evoking a gut-chip's limited nutrient exposure -- not a calibrated epithelial model.

injury_stress_chip_like.label: High-stress injury-chip-like
injury_stress_chip_like.description: Illustrative low-flow, high-exogenous-stress profile evoking a toxicology/injury framing -- the highest deliberate stressor of these presets.
